The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.
The Bulgarian featured contents in BTFB has provided a quite unique gameplay.

With BTFB enacted, Bulgaria will face the faction struggle within its nation. Spending lots of PP can have them all satisfied but it really costs. Note that some NFs may change the status of these factions, so a rational plan before engaging is adoptable.

In historical rountine, the player can choose to join Axis but not participate in the war, then utilize the decision to directly transfer faction members' controlled non-core states in Balkan to their ownership, while the faction members even do not need to own them. For example, Axis Bulgaria can ask Italy for Kosovo (controlled by ITA) and Albania (owned thus controlled by ITA), while can not ask Hungary for Vojvodina because Hungary has a core there so it has no stress in occupation. When these countries find themselves lacking weapons to suppress, they would be more likely to transfer these states to Bulgaria. And when Bulgaria receives these states and ⟦0⟧, it will just ⟦1⟧ them.

If Bulgaria chooses to expand in its NF tree branch, no matter by force or not, it can have cores in the whole Balkan region at most. Bulgarian branch uses a unique core-creating mechanic, while the democratic or communist Balkan branch directly gives them all at once. Note that Bulgaria can never get cores outside of Balkan - even though it may annex Turkey through its democratic Balkan branch, it can not have cores outside of the Asian part of Istanbul.

Bulgaria lacks manpower, but has a strong NFs tree focusing on the quality of military. It especially suits such a gaming way, that utilzing the bonuses to design or buy some mechanized vehicles, thus to be an elite force in the German-Soviet battlefield, no matter the side it stands on (there are some pressure of defending when standing with Soviet Union, but get cores much quicker).

You will want to invade Greece as they are your weakest neighbor so turn Fascist or Communist and justify upon them (fascism is advised as the Axis are bordering you and are potentially more useful allies and the manpower gained from militarism is a good buff). Do not puppet Greece as Italy can get a war goal on them and it would take a large naval buildup to challenge the Italian Navy not to mention that Italy would call in Germany providing they are both Fascist and Germany would be very difficult to hold off. If the world tension is low enough or ww2 has started, justify on Turkey. You should navally invade as the Bosporus straits are difficult to cross. After this, you could invade Yugoslavia although you may want to be quick because they tend to join the Axis or Allies. You could potentially invade Romania but they may join the Axis so go in at your own risk. After this, you could join the Allies, Axis, or Comintern and potentially change the course of ww2. The choice is yours.
